Build Without Limits

A modern game development environment for creating Bloxd worlds without being locked into one language or workflow.

Code in Your Language

Use the language you already know. Ada, Java, Go, Python and more.

Whether you're a Minecraft modder, Godot developer, Unity user, or just getting started, Voxelium gives you a familiar way to build for Bloxd.

Powerful Developer Tools

Get built-in tools and APIs for common game-development tasks.

Need audio? Use VXAudioManager. Building a large system? Voxelium is designed to handle projects of all sizes.

High-Performance Code

Voxelium can compile your code into efficient, low-level representations designed for performance.

Need pointers or manual memory-style operations? Voxelium can provide them while handling the underlying memory management for you.
